macos.label: macOS
macos.requirement: macOS 13 or later · Apple Silicon and Intel
macos.description: Open the disk image, open Agent Zero Browser Setup, and choose Install browser companion. No administrator password is needed. Updates preserve your pairing.

windows.label: Windows
windows.requirement: Native companion installer not released yet
windows.description: You can load this Chrome extension on Windows, but browser control needs the Windows companion. Its installer and platform verification are still incomplete. The Mac installer, WSL, and a Docker container cannot replace it.

linux.label: Linux
linux.requirement: Native companion installer not released yet
linux.description: You can load this Chrome extension on Linux, but browser control needs a released Linux companion. Current x86-64 and ARM64 builds are candidates, not supported installers. Desktop Secret Service and a conventional Chrome package are required; Snap and Flatpak browser integration is not supported.
